description: Given a plain-language description of a UI need, finds the best-matching component across the indexed shadcn-format registries (react-bits, magicui, aceternity, kokonutui, animate-ui, motion-primitives, shadcn-dashboard, assistant-ui, bundui, cnippet, uiable, plate, react-aria, shadcn-ui-blocks). Returns one of three outcomes: confident (one clear winner), shortlist (several strong candidates with the differentiating dimension named), or no_match (nothing fits, closest candidates shown but marked rejected). Never a forced best guess.

brief.description: Plain-language description of the component needed, any language

maxResults.description: Max candidates to return for a shortlist or no_match outcome (default 3)

registry.description: Restrict the search to one registry

name: pick_component
title: Pick a shadcn-format component
